response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud technologies (AWS CDK), as well as a proven track record in AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators). However, his direct experience with GenAI-specific technologies (vector databases, RAG, multi-agent systems) is limited to recent work at re:cinq, and his background is heavily skewed toward web/mobile development rather than AI/ML delivery. His lack of formal AI degree (though he has a CS bachelor's) and minimal public evidence of LLM optimization expertise are notable concerns.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience with TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud platforms (AWS, Docker)
Recent AI-agent infrastructure experience (MCP, developer tooling for agentic workflows)
Demonstrated leadership in technical architecture and mentorship (e.g., organizing workshops, TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: Limited direct experience with GenAI core technologies (vector databases, RAG, multi-agent systems) outside recent role
No clear evidence of LLM performance metrics or optimization expertise
Primary background is web/mobile development rather than AI/ML delivery; AI work appears to be a recent pivot
